nodes.label: Neon Logs
nodes.source_location: Logs: CLI, Loki, and SDK pagination
nodes.rationale: Branch-scoped logs. Today only Neon Functions and Object Storage emit records. Postgres compute and the AI Gateway do not yet. A branch that cannot serve logs returns 404 with reason telemetry_not_enabled; an enabled branch with no rows in the window returns 200 empty; an unknown branch returns reason branch_not_found. Query the branch that hosts the deployed function or bucket. Without --branch the CLI uses the branch pinned in .neon, or the project default, so an empty result is often the wrong branch. The window defaults to 1 hour on query and 6 hours on field-values and cannot exceed 7 days. --source accepts pg_endpoint, but that source stays empty until Postgres logs ship. If --minimum-severity is unsupported, use a case-sensitive --severity-text match. LogQL uses the stream label entity_type, not source. Prefer Neon CLI 3.1 or newer, then the MCP read-only log tools. In @neon/sdk, query is a lazy paginated iterable that throws on error, while fields and fieldValues follow throwOnError, which defaults to false. fieldValues can set is_truncated, in which case values are an arbitrary subset.

nodes.label: Loki-compatible read API
nodes.rationale: Read-only HTTP subset for branch logs, authenticated with a Neon API key bearer token. It is not a push endpoint or a complete Loki deployment. query_range supports LogQL stream selectors and line filters, plus since or start/end, limit, and direction. It does not support aggregations, parsers, or formatting stages. A Grafana data source appends /loki/api/v1 to the URL it is given, so confirm that data-source URL against the Neon docs instead of pasting the console base unchanged.
